scenes.title: Seat 6 student squinting at two white line-comparison cards as five confederates call out the wrong line

layout.description: Sunlit 1951 college classroom with a curved semi-circular wooden table seating seven male student mannequins facing an easel at the front holding two large white posterboard cards with crisp vertical black ink lines.

positions.who: Critical Subject in Seat 6 (mannequin in 1950s knit sweater vest and collared shirt)
positions.where: seated second from the right end, leaning forward and squinting incredulously toward the easel
positions.facing: facing the two white line cards

positions.who: Confederates 1 through 5 (mannequins in 1950s tweed jackets and Oxford shirts)
positions.where: seated calmly along the curved table to his left
positions.facing: turning slightly as each announces the identical wrong number

positions.where: standing beside the wooden easel flipping the pair of white line cards
positions.facing: facing the row of seven students

props.name: standard vertical line card (left)
props.period_detail: crisp white 1950s posterboard displaying a single medium-length black vertical line
props.physical_behavior: mounted upright on the left side of the wooden easel

props.name: three-line comparison card (right)
props.period_detail: matching white posterboard displaying lines 1, 2, and 3 where Line 2 clearly matches the standard while Line 1 is visibly shorter
props.physical_behavior: stands beside the standard card in plain daylight

props.name: experimenter's trial ledger
props.physical_behavior: pen marks whether Seat 6 yields or stands independent

actions.verb_sequence: point calmly one by one toward the easel -> announce the identical blatantly wrong comparison line
leans forward and blinks hard at the two white cards -> glances nervously down the row of five calm peers -> wavers in silent conflict before speaking

reactions.reaction: slumps his shoulders slightly under five pairs of calm gazes as he decides whether to betray his own eyes
holds a neutral expression beside the easel while recording the spoken number

scenes.wardrobe: 1951 American collegiate attire: Oxford button-down shirts, wool sweater vests, tweed sport coats, pleated trousers; experimenter in dark 1950s suit and tie.
scenes.lighting: High-key natural afternoon classroom daylight illuminating the black lines on white posterboard with zero ambiguity.
scenes.recognition_hook: Five calm students in a row call out an obviously wrong black line on a white easel card, leaving Seat 6 sweating over whether to trust his own eyes.

key_visual.description: six male students in 1950s collegiate attire seated at a curved seminar table facing an easel with two white poster cards displaying black vertical comparison lines

scenes.title: Control group writing answers alone with 99 percent accuracy

layout.description: Quiet classroom desks where individual student mannequins write line numbers silently on paper slips without spoken peer answers.

positions.where: seated at separate wooden desks writing calmly

props.name: paper response sheet
props.physical_behavior: pencil records >99 percent accurate line matches

actions.verb_sequence: glances once at the easel -> writes the obvious matching number immediately

scenes.recognition_hook: Alone on paper, error rates sit below one percent.

scenes.title: One truthful ally in Seat 4 shatters unanimity

layout.description: Same curved seven-seat seminar table facing the line-card easel, where Seat 4 speaks the true line number ahead of Seat 6.

positions.where: sitting upright and pointing clearly to the true matching line
straightening his posture immediately as tension evaporates
positions.facing: looking gratefully toward Seat 4 and the easel

props.name: comparison line cards on easel
props.physical_behavior: now backed by one honest voice in Seat 4

actions.verb_sequence: breaks the false chant with the accurate line number -> Seat 6 sits tall and states the true number firmly

reactions.reaction: exhales visibly as conformity plunges from 36.8 percent to 5.5 percent

scenes.recognition_hook: Just one honest voice in the room slashes conformity by eighty percent.

scenes.title: Silent written ballots before a modern team vote

layout.description: Sunlit modern glass conference table where six team mannequins jot independent votes on index cards before anyone speaks.

positions.where: seated around a light oak table writing silently on cards

props.name: white index ballot cards
props.period_detail: six silent written vote cards turned face-up simultaneously
props.physical_behavior: reveals honest disagreement before group pressure forms

actions.verb_sequence: collects silent cards -> turns them face-up together on the table

reactions.reaction: lean in constructively to compare independent views

scenes.wardrobe: Clean modern smart-casual blazers and shirts.
scenes.recognition_hook: Writing answers down privately cuts group distortion by two-thirds.
